rounds.response: Report means and SDs when treating 5‑point Likert items as approximately continuous, but include medians/IQRs (or both) if distributions are skewed and state your choice and rationale. For rounding: use one decimal for means/SDs and medians/IQRs, two decimals for coefficients and effect sizes (e.g., d), two–three decimals for standard errors, and report p‑values to three decimals (use p < .001 when smaller). Standardizing predictors is fine — label those coefficients clearly and interpret them as change per SD; you can include unstandardized results in an appendix for transparency. I prefer two short paragraphs (one per concept) so each idea is clearly linked to the same result and easy for the grader to find. Post your draft table or interpretation in the forum and I’ll give quick feedback.
